answer: Sleep is easier if you finish exercising at least one hour before bedtime, because that naturally boosts sleepiness. It’s fine to take a hot shower or drink a cup of coffee in the last hour to relax your body and dull your mind. Night-lights or a small TV in the dark actually help to calm you, so feel free to leave them on while you sleep. If you still can’t drift off, consider a short 20-30-minute power nap at night to make up for lost time and you won’t need to worry about blowing your sleep schedule.
